name: Hyde Park Barracks Museum
blurb: A World Heritage convict barracks, brought to life by a free immersive audio tour.
weatherNote: Almost all indoors. You only cross the open courtyard between buildings.
gettingThere: Train to St James (4 min), then a 7 min walk across Queens Square to the Macquarie St entrance.
newcomerTip: Entry is free; booking a timed session online is recommended, not required. The free audio guide knows where you're standing (about 90 min, best for ages 8+) and comes in eight languages.

dest.label: Hyde Park Barracks, Macquarie St entrance

legs.title: Train to St James

legs.title: Across Queens Square to the Macquarie St entrance

back.text: Same way back from St James station (7 min walk), or walk 7 min to Martin Place for the M1 metro to Central.

notes: The museum has no public parking. Metered street parking around Hyde Park and the Botanic Garden is limited.
Wilson's Domain car park is $19 drive-up on weekends ($15.75–17.75 online), or $32–48 for 2–3 hours on weekdays. Its lifts are out of order at the moment.

visit.bestTime: Any day. Book online first to pick your session time and skip the queue.
visit.hours: Open daily 10am to 6pm, last entry 4:30pm. Audio sessions start every half hour. Closed Good Friday and Christmas Day.
bring: Your own headphones if you like (3.5 mm jack or Lightning)
facilities: Toilets, a family room with a change table and an accessible toilet in the rear building
Free lockers at the rear of the site
visit.access: Ramps give a continuous path through the site and the main building has a lift. A mobility version of the audio tour, neck loops, a descriptive version and captioned iPads are available. Wheelchairs and video magnifiers are free to borrow: book on 02 8239 2211.
safety: Some rooms have bright, flickering lights and large ocean projections
Children under 15 must stay with an adult
